stories.title: A woman bodyslams the guy who threw a drink on her
stories.summary: A livestream clip showed a man throwing a drink on a woman, then her taking him to the floor while a crowd filmed. The clip got 65K likes, and a quote post saying the men around them only stepped in "when she started beating his ass good" got 250K. The replies turned into a fight over whether the bystanders should have stepped in sooner and who they were really protecting.
